**Is your feature request related to a problem?**

A clear description of the problem.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

What should happen, in user-visible terms.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**

Other approaches and why you didn't pick them.

**Scope**

- [ ] Affects the proxy server (`src/proxy.ts`, `src/upstream.ts`)
- [ ] Affects auth (`src/auth.ts`)
- [ ] Affects OpenCode setup (`src/setup.ts`)
- [ ] Affects the model catalogue (`src/models.ts`)
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Other: ___

**Are you willing to send a PR?**

If yes, see `CONTRIBUTING.md` before you start.
